aliases.E24CT: → 190-E24 (transporte). 'CT' no es SKU de transporte recto; usar 190-E24.
aliases.LBP: banda modular genérica (Low Back Pressure); Hytrol no publica SKU 'LBP' en estas páginas.
aliases.LBP-CURVE: → SBC (curva de banda de cama deslizante).

facts.quote: 1.9" diameter x 16 ga. rollers on 3" centers; Section lengths are available in 6" increments from 2' to 10'; Standard conveying speed of 25-174 FPM; Maximum of 37 lbs. per foot and a maximum capacity per E24 motor of 75 lbs.

1.9" diameter x 16 ga. rollers on 3" centers; EZLogic zone controllers can be located in 18", 24", 30", or 36" zones; maximum capacity is 37 lbs. per foot, 75 lbs. per zone, standard conveying speed of 25-174 FPM.
2.5" diameters tapered to 1-11/16" diameter x 16 ga. rollers; 30- and 45-degree curves require (1) 24-volt motor; 60- and 90-degree curves require (2) 24-volt motors.
1.9" diameter x 16 ga. rollers on 3" centers; 30-degree spur ... on 12"-16" OAW at 30" long ... 45-degree spur ... on 12"-42" OAW; Section lengths for the 45-degree include 21", 36", and 48".
Available in 2" or 3" roller centers; Variable 30-180 FPM; Included casters and inset supports; Max capacity of 70 lbs. per linear foot; 36/48" BR.
1.9" diameter x 16 ga. rollers on 4" or 6" centers; Standard conveying speed of 28 FPM; Maximum unit load not to exceed 600 lbs. per zone.

Belt Width 6" 8" 10" 12" 14" 16" 18" 20" 24" 30"; Bed Width 10" 12" 14" 16" 18" 20" 22" 24" 28" 34" (bed = belt + 4"). Slider bed (belt over steel pan), 4"/8" end or center drive, take-up at tail pulley. Floor supports at both ends of drive section and one end of intermediate/tail sections.

Tread rollers mounted in 6 in. x 4 ga. formed steel channel frame to form 1-5/8 in. high guard rails. (Descripción de la familia de bastidores de rodillo vivo Hytrol; no confirmada verbatim en el cuerpo del PDF extraído — origen: resultados de catálogo Hytrol 190.)

Soportes de piso ajustables: SUPPORT PIPE + SIDE CHANNEL + SUPPORT LEG + STATIONARY SUPPORT; 'Frame Weldment (Specify Height)'. Se nivelan a la altura requerida y se anclan al piso (lag). Opción Poly-Tier.
